metadata.title: Careers at Deckwise: Build AI Presentation Workflows
metadata.description: Join Deckwise to build AI presentation software for teams that turn research, files, and feedback into editable slide decks.

hero.title: Join us in building the next generation of knowledge work tools.
hero.body: When teams can adapt software to the way they actually work, more problems get solved faster. Our mission is to make workspaces that connect knowledge, projects, and AI available to everyone.

story.title: our story
story.body1: Deckwise grew out of a straightforward question: why does team work become more fragmented as tools multiply? Documents, files, chats, and demos keep growing, but real project context often has no stable home.
story.body2: We hope to build a workspace that teams can shape freely: as light as a blank sheet of paper, but capable of holding complex projects, knowledge bases, materials, and AI assistance.
story.body3: This requires product, engineering, design, research, marketing and customer teams to work closely together. We're looking for people who are willing to hone basic tools over the long term.

culture.title: How Deckwise works
culture.body: We believe the best products come from consistent use, direct feedback, and sharp quality judgment. The team stays small, focused, and fast around real user problems.

craft.title: Pay attention to craftsmanship
craft.body: We care about details, performance, maintainability, and the smoothness that users truly feel every day.

speed.title: maintain speed
speed.body: Use clear boundaries and direct communication to reduce waiting and get good ideas into verifiable products as quickly as possible.

truth.title: pursue facts
truth.body: Stay honest in the face of data, user feedback, and technical constraints, and use evidence to drive decisions.

metadata.title: Deckwise Security: Privacy Controls for AI Presentations
metadata.description: See how Deckwise protects AI presentation projects with privacy controls, secure workspace boundaries, and enterprise-ready reliability.

hero.title: Your safety, security and privacy are our priorities.
hero.body: Deckwise protects team data from product design, infrastructure, permission control, and AI usage, allowing companies to safely put knowledge and projects into the same workspace.

security.title: safe
security.body: Deckwise uses a security-by-design approach to protect data. From transmission to storage to processing, we reduce risk through layered controls.

infrastructure.title: security infrastructure
infrastructure.body: Data transmission and storage are protected with encryption and exposure is reduced through least privilege access, key management, monitoring and vulnerability remediation processes.

operations.title: Operational security
operations.body: Security teams continuously monitor infrastructure, network and product assets to promptly respond to abnormal behavior and potential threats.

product.title: product safety
product.body: Enterprise administrators can configure SSO, member provisioning, audit logs, guest access, and fine-grained permissions to enhance organizational visibility and control.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Deckwise is committed to handling customer data in a transparent and controlled manner and to letting customers understand how data is collected, used and protected.

data.title: Data processing
data.body: We establish processes and safeguards around the data lifecycle, including collection, processing, storage, access and deletion.

agreements.title: Agreements and Commitments
agreements.body: Our service agreement, data processing terms and privacy statement are continuously updated to reflect regulations and industry practices.

governance.title: data governance
governance.body: Help customers keep their data secure, accurate, private and manageable through clear policies and access boundaries.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.body: Deckwise is building a security and privacy program for enterprise customers to help teams manage their workspaces to industry standards.

ai.title: AI governance
ai.body: Deckwise’s AI capabilities are designed around trustworthiness, explainability, and controllability. Customer data will not be used to train generic models, and permission boundaries will be respected in AI access.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.body: Teams need a workspace that is always available. Deckwise improves service reliability through monitoring, backups, recovery plans, and status transparency.

cta.title: Need advanced security and controls?
cta.body: Tell us about your enterprise deployment, compliance or permissions needs and we'll help you plan the right workspace solution.

metadata.title: OpenAI Customer Story: Faster Deck Workflows with Deckwise
metadata.description: See how teams can use Deckwise to share project context, reuse knowledge, draft presentations, and move faster from research to editable decks.

hero.title: How OpenAI turns shared knowledge into faster workflows with Deckwise

openai.lede: Behind every AI system is the foundation of human knowledge. The OpenAI team needed a place to capture this knowledge, organize project context, and turn shared thinking into faster execution.

centralized.title: Centralizing work in one place releases power
centralized.body1: As an organization grows, planning, research, and decision-making tend to be spread across different tools. The OpenAI team needed a shared space where work would remain searchable and connectable as the company grew.
centralized.body2: This workspace becomes the foundation for translating research notes, release plans, product context, and team knowledge into action. Through integrations and AI-assisted search, the right context can flow with the work rather than being locked away in silos.

research.title: Open up the pipeline from research to products
research.body1: Research teams document experiments and plans in real-time team spaces, then connect this work to engineering and product processes. The result is a clearer path from discovery to release.
research.body2: Kanban boards, lists, and timelines allow each team to organize the same knowledge base around their own processes while keeping the larger project readable to collaborators.

engineering.title: Speed amplifier and always-on assistant for engineering teams
engineering.body1: When debugging records, design decisions, and code reviews are kept where the next teammate can find them, engineering knowledge continues to compound. Searchable workspaces make these contexts useful across time zones and handoffs.
engineering.body2: Rather than starting from scratch to troubleshoot issues, teams can build on existing knowledge and ask the workspace for the most relevant context when pressure is highest.

data.title: Make data accessible and actionable
data.body1: Data teams can turn weekly reports, dashboards, and operational metrics into a shared reporting hub. Leaders can see numbers that impact the roadmap faster without having to hunt for information in multiple systems.
data.body2: Templates and embedded dashboards reduce repetitive report preparation while keeping analytical context next to the data.

gtm.title: Faster global GTM engine
gtm.body1: GTM teams can move faster when product news, customer stories, release notes and enabling materials are in one connected repository.
gtm.body2: This shared system helps new members onboard faster, keeps sales conversations current, and gives customer-facing teams a clearer view of product strategy.

impact.title: The impact of centralized work and knowledge
impact.body1: The core lesson is simple: when project context and drafts stay together, knowledge is more easily reused. Teams can move from idea to decision to release without losing the derivation process.
impact.body2: This shared foundation keeps high-velocity teams aligned while still giving each function the structure it needs.
